REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: Authority separation, gate-set matching, receipt content signatures, token accounting, RCA safeguards, and package coverage are otherwise sound. However, high-impact review independence is replayable: the validator permits Sol and Opus receipts to reference the same raw review artifact, contradicting the contract’s claim that one artifact cannot receive two labels.
FINDING: high|scripts/factory-ng-provenance-validate.py|High-impact uniqueness checks omit review_receipt.raw_review_sha256, allowing two distinct signed receipt wrappers to reuse one raw review|This permits one review artifact to satisfy independent Sol-and-Opus approval and violates replay resistance
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Require distinct raw_review_sha256 values across accepted high-impact reviews and add an invalid fixture exercising duplicated raw-review content with otherwise distinct IDs, attempts, receipt digests, profiles, and attestations.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: Copy the Sol raw_review_sha256 into the Opus receipt, assign distinct review_id/review_attempt_id, recompute its attestation and review_sha256, then attest the provenance envelope; the current validator accepts both as independent approvals.
